round1: Derrick and Stephanie tied for the lead at 17 points, while Marc brought up the rear with 10. Only Stephanie believed in Ottawa over New Jersey, which makes her the only person who has watched hockey this decade.
round2: Four of five of you picked Edmonton to beat Dallas, and Dallas won it in five. Jaclyn picked every series in six games and still led the round with 13 points, while Chrissy fell to 4 after picking Ottawa and Montreal.
round3: Jaclyn pulled away with 16 points and grabbed the lead from Derrick, with Marc close behind at 15. Derrick, Stephanie and Chrissy combined for 11 points between them and made a strong case for taking a round off.
round4: All five of you picked Washington, and Detroit swept the Capitals in four. Unanimous, confident and completely wrong, so nobody scored a point and the standings stayed exactly as they were.
overall: Jaclyn won back-to-back pools with 42 points, with Marc finishing second at 34 after coming dead last in 1997. Chrissy ended last at 23 points, not helped by a Round 4 where the whole pool unanimously picked the wrong Cup finalist. Marc, Derrick and Stephanie have now all picked the wrong Cup winner two years running, which is a streak nobody wants.
